title: Unary tableau output
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $z$ be a finite bit string, with $T\geq 1$. The counter program's output on the input consisting of $n$ ones, a zero, $T$ ones, a zero, and then $z$ is the encoding of the circuit tableau for $M$, input width $n$, suffix $z$, and time bound $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
